select
b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as monthPlan, b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY as monthPlanOs, c.COLOR_TYPE, c.COLOR_CODE, d.notes
from t_gdyy_schedule_result a
LEFT JOIN ( select MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY,YEAR,MONTH from T_GDYY_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS where del_flag = '0' ) b on a.BIG_ROLL_CODE=b.MATERIAL_CODE and b.YEAR = TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date,'yyyy') and b.MONTH = TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date,'MM')
LEFT JOIN T_GDYY_BIG_ROLL_COLOR c ON a.BIG_ROLL_CODE = c.BIG_ROLL_CODE AND c.STATUS = '0' AND c.DEL_FLAG = '0'
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BIG_ROLL_CODE, START_TIME, END_TIME,listagg(notes,',') within group (order by notes) notes FROM T_GDYY_NOTE WHERE STATUS = '0' AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BIG_ROLL_CODE,START_TIME, END_TIME) d
ON d.BIG_ROLL_CODE = a.BIG_ROLL_CODE AND d.START_TIME <= a.schedule_date AND d.END_TIME >= a.schedule_date
where a.id = #{id}
